sehemu: Part V: Court of Appeal of the United Republic
jina: Matters that may be decided by a single Justice of Appeal
maudhui: A single Justice of Appeal may exercise any power of the Court of Appeal which does not involve determining an appeal, provided that: (a) in criminal proceedings, where the Justice gives a decision with which the applicant is dissatisfied, the applicant shall be entitled to have the application determined by the Court of Appeal; and (b) in civil proceedings, the Court of Appeal may set aside or vary an order, direction or other decision made by a single Justice of Appeal under this Article.
